a.title: Four real parts, drawn by Kosika
a.summary: A heart, a cell, a transistor and an engine cylinder, each drawn from what it is made of.

beats.text: The heart: two atria on top, two ventricles below, and the vessels leaving it.
A cell: its nucleus, the mitochondria that make its energy, and ribosomes building proteins.
An NPN transistor: a small current into the base B lets a larger one flow from C to E.
One engine cylinder: the piston rises and falls, and the rod turns the crank.
